text: Concord Avenue, between College Street and Dewson Street, is a local street that serves both local residents and the nearby Dewson Street Junior Public School. Residents contacted my office to raise concerns about the lack of available parking during weekday afternoons and evenings, particularly for permit holders returning home from work. I joined local residents and Transportation Services staff for a site meeting to better understand these concerns and discuss possible solutions. During the meeting, the existing street parking regulations were shown to be inconsistent and confusing about where and when residents can park. Following an additional review, Transportation Services identified parking amendments to resolve these issues, including aligning the school bus loading and short-term parking restrictions with school operating hours. I recommend authorizing the parking amendments…
